data.one_liner: A tool for maintaining Dart documentation comments and formatting embedded code examples.
data.what_it_does: Daco formats documentation comments as Markdown using prettier and formats/analyzes embedded Dart code examples. It provides both an analyzer plugin for syntax errors and a `daco analyze` command for full semantic analysis.
use_when: You want to automatically format and wrap documentation comments and markdown tables
You want syntax and semantic checking for Dart code examples inside doc comments
You use prettier for Markdown formatting in your Dart project workflow
avoid_when: You do not use Markdown for documentation comments
You cannot install NodeJS on your path (required for prettier)
strengths: Supports recursive formatting of doc comments and embedded Dart code
Integrates with the Dart analyzer plugin to catch syntax errors in examples
Performs full semantic analysis via `daco analyze`
weaknesses: Requires a recent version of NodeJS (>=14) installed on the path
Potential changes to dartdoc tag locations when formatting preexisting codebases
data.setup_notes: Requires NodeJS (>=14) installed on the path. Add daco as a dev dependency, enable the analyzer plugin in analysis_options.yaml, and optionally install globally via pub global activate.
